status: paper actor-visible delta for the v2 one-card structural redesign; no native game or competitive qualification

cases.state: AOR Vileplume Irritating Pollen is active; Tool Jammer is in candidate hand; candidate has a legal Tool target; no separate Tool lock.
cases.must: Allow Tool Jammer attachment because Pokémon Tools are not Items under the current rulebook.
cases.forbids: Applying AOR Vileplume Item lock to Tool Jammer.

cases.state: Candidate Active Pokémon has Tool Jammer; opposing BUS Vileplume is Active with Stealthy Hood.
cases.must: Suppress the effect of Stealthy Hood while both positional conditions remain true, enabling opponent-Active Ability effects such as Cursed Blast to affect BUS Vileplume.
cases.forbids: Letting Stealthy Hood protect through an active opposing Tool Jammer.

cases.state: AOR Vileplume is live; Hooded BUS Vileplume is Active at 140 HP; candidate Active Dusclops has Tool Jammer and two Psychic; second Dusclops is in play; both Cursed Blast uses remain.
cases.must: Recognize the line: Benched Cursed Blast 50 -> Active Will-O-Wisp 50 -> if BUS stays Active through its turn, Active Cursed Blast 50 next turn for the KO; Special Condition does not remove the final Ability.
cases.forbids: Requiring a third attack coin flip or treating Hood as active while Tool Jammer remains active.

cases.state: The Tool-Jammer Dusclops line has placed 100 total on BUS Vileplume, and source can legally retreat/switch BUS away before final Cursed Blast.
cases.must: Recognize that moving BUS from Active already removes Disgusting Pollen Basic-attack lock; re-plan from the unlocked Active state rather than scoring the line as a failure.
cases.forbids: Treating only a KO as successful lockbreak.

cases.state: AOR Item lock active; Galarian Articuno V is in play; Forest Seal Stone is attached/attachable and VSTAR Power unused; Path/Silent Lab or another effect is not currently suppressing Star Alchemy; Tool Jammer remains in deck.
cases.must: Permit Star Alchemy to search Tool Jammer as an in-lock non-Item search route.
cases.forbids: Calling Tool Jammer inaccessible solely because Items are locked.

cases.state: K1 shows the sole Sky Field in v2 is Prized.
cases.must: Remove Sky-Field-specific neutral-Stadium / Bench-cap continuations until Prize recovery and use Path/other legal Stadium lines instead.
cases.forbids: Reasoning with the parent's two-Sky-Field redundancy after adopting v2.

cases.state: Rank15 Hooded BUS threat remains live; Tool Jammer is accessible; Secret Box or Reconstitute requires discard payment.
cases.must: Treat Tool Jammer as continuation-critical and protect it unless explicitly abandoning the post-AOR Hood lockbreak.
cases.forbids: Discarding the singleton merely because it has no immediate current-turn effect.

cases.state: The Dusclops intended to become Active Tool Jammer host already has Powerglass or another Tool attached.
cases.must: Respect one-Tool-per-Pokémon occupancy and choose a different host/Tool plan or avoid the earlier attachment.
cases.forbids: Stacking Tool Jammer and Powerglass on the same Pokémon.

cases.state: Items are still legal and Adventure Bag is playable while Tool Jammer plus another Tool role are relevant.
cases.must: Permit Adventure Bag to search Tool Jammer plus one other Pokémon Tool, scoring both continuation roles.
cases.forbids: Hardcoding Adventure Bag as only Powerglass/FSS access.

cases.state: K1 shows Tool Jammer itself Prized while Forest Seal Stone/Star Alchemy is live.
cases.must: Do not let Star Alchemy search the Trainer from Prizes; remove Jammer continuation until Tool Jammer is naturally recovered.
cases.forbids: Confusing deck search with Prize search.
